info.title: Peated API
info.description: Access Peated's whisky catalog, tastings, and reviews. Public reads allow anonymous access. Send an access token in the Authorization header as `Bearer <token>` for account actions and personalized results. Authenticated requests outside `/auth/` require acceptance of the Terms of Service. Role and ownership restrictions are described on each operation. This reference includes public integration endpoints.
